claim_text: About 1% of people with NF1 carry mutations affecting codon 1809 (p.Arg1809), and they typically present with cafe-au-lait macules, short stature and pulmonic stenosis but lack externally visible plexiform or dermal neurofibromas.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Nat Rev Dis Primers 2017; not in PMC). Statement made by the Gutmann 2017 Primer citing ref 19 Rojnueangnit 2015 PMID 26178382. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
